embeds.title: BLHA SCOUTING
embeds.description: One forum for every prospect: college, juniors, Europe, the AHL, the NHL Draft and the BLHA draft.

fields.name: HOW IT WORKS
fields.value: Make one post per player or topic, and search before you post so each prospect keeps one thread. Add tags for the league, the player's status and position.

fields.name: TAGS
fields.value:
**League:** NCAA • CHL • AHL • EUROPE/INTL • NHL DRAFT
**Status:** TOP PROSPECT • SLEEPER • RISER • FALLER • NHL READY • LONG SHOT
**Position:** FORWARD • DEFENSE • GOALIE
**BLHA draft:** BLHA DRAFT • RANKINGS • MOCK DRAFT

fields.name: MINOR-LEAGUE RULES
fields.value: Minor-league spots are for players 25 or younger (per Fantrax's age calculation) with 100 or fewer career NHL games (50 for goalies). Details are in Article VII.

fields.name: THE BLHA DRAFT
fields.value: 5 rounds, linear order, starting 14 to 21 days after the NHL Entry Draft; the first Annual Draft is in 2028. The pool is any unowned player who qualifies for a minor-league spot, not just the NHL Draft class (Article XIV). Official draft notices are in the Draft Center.

fields.name: NEWS FEED
fields.value: Automated prospect news appears in **prospect-wire**. Come here to talk about what it means.
